source_triangle_indexing: Original print_batch *.3mf triangle order, before source_to_plate Z rotation/translation. Normals unchanged under Z rotations.
triangle_visibility_method: Down normals nz<-sqrt(.5); exclude bed. Centroid ray downward: omit all surfaces with any mesh crossing >=0.03 mm below, excluding closed inner holes/pockets. Does not assess tree path collision or removal access.
